reasoning: Small, discrete, dark/black irregular spots on an otherwise green tomato leaf are most consistent with Bacterial Speck of Tomato, which causes tiny dark lesions on leaves. The spots lack the lighter centers of Septoria, the concentric rings of Early Blight, or the large water-soaked zones of Late Blight. The whitish granular material is likely spray residue. Confidence is moderate as Septoria Leaf Blotch also presents with similar small dark leaf spots.
